goal: Start New Game. Choose a starter home, create a household, change your zombie's appearance, then enter the game. Use only this game window.
Buy an affordable refrigerator and place it on a clear floor tile. Confirm it stays placed and the funds change. Use only this game window.
Move an existing chair to another clear floor tile. Confirm its new location. Use only this game window.
Sell one existing chair. Confirm the chair disappears and funds increase. Use only this game window.
In Build mode, add a window to an empty wall edge. Watch whether a valid green preview actually becomes a placed window when clicked. Report any mismatch. Use only this game window.
Add a door to an empty wall edge. Confirm it appears where the preview was. Use only this game window.
Build a short straight wall by dragging across three clear tiles. Inspect the preview during the drag and confirm the final wall matches it. Report any mismatch. Use only this game window.
Buy and place one affordable item, undo the placement, then redo it. Confirm the object and funds change each time. Use only this game window.
Save the household, return to the main menu, then Continue. Confirm the same household and home return. Use only this game window.
Change the zombie's body style and outfit, then start playing. Confirm your chosen zombie appears in the world. Use only this game window.
